seo.description: About Al Mamun, a PHP, Laravel, WordPress and cloud software engineer in Bangladesh, with experience in AdTech, e-commerce, AI infrastructure and Linux systems.

profile.name: AL MAMUN
profile.title: Software Engineer | PHP | Laravel | Linux | WordPress | AWS
profile.summary: Results-driven Full-Stack Software Engineer with expertise in PHP, Laravel, WordPress, JavaScript and Next.js. I specialize in backend architecture, frontend development, AdTech, custom e-commerce applications and Linux server administration. I diagnose complex problems systematically, trace them to their root causes and build clean, long-term solutions.

points: Architect scalable Laravel and Next.js applications and deliver AdTech features across client projects with 100% on-time releases.
Deploy applications across AWS and local VPS/intranet environments, reducing hosting expenses by approximately 30%.
Established a privacy-focused local Ollama infrastructure and led technical sessions with international clients on architecture, performance and security.
Built Laravel, Next.js, React and PHP applications and refactored complex queries to improve database performance by 35%.
Advised teams on cloud, latency and architecture across Laravel, CakePHP, CodeIgniter and Node.js projects.
Reduced infrastructure costs by 30–40% through cloud migration and managed production pipelines and maintenance.
Contributed to full-stack web applications and maintained reliable deployment and support workflows.
Engineered Laravel e-commerce features in a multi-tenant repository with complete tenant isolation.
Optimized MySQL queries for a 25% speed improvement and managed AWS deployments and client communication.
Modernized file sharing with Synology NAS and Windows Server 2019 Active Directory, achieving 99.9% uptime for 12+ employees.
Developed a WordPress 3D/IFC model viewer, integrated ZKTeCO systems and configured Zoho Mail, IP phones and network security.
Maintained web systems and managed company IT, networks and technical infrastructure.
Built WebGL and OpenStreetMap visualizations for cadastral survey datasets and improved data-processing efficiency by 30%.
Delivered 40+ WordPress, WooCommerce and Laravel solutions with over 95% client satisfaction.
Improved site load times by up to 40%, optimized deployments and maintained 99.9% uptime.
